prompt: How many years apart was the founding of Snell & Wilmer from the birth of the man who got 3rd place at the 1954 Masters golf tournament?
answer:
Snell & Wilmer was founded in **1938**. The 1954 Masters’ third-place finisher was **Lloyd Mangrum**, who was born in **1914**.

Therefore, the founding and his birth were **24 years apart**.
